title: Can we go to the park after this?
scene: 他提议等下做某件事，并补充理由。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can we go to the park after this?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I want to feed the ducks.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Then we stop for bread first.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Please? The brown one waits by the bench.

variations: "the park" 换 "the library"；"feed the ducks" 换 "read a book"。
